commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Mario Martin (Getafe) was quite harsh and Isidro Diaz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+5' The foul by Diego Rico (Getafe) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Isidro Diaz.
90+2' Ath Bilbao concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
88' Domingos Duarte (Getafe) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Isidro Diaz had an easy-decision to make.
88' Half-chance! Jesus Areso (Ath Bilbao) plays a pass into the box, but David Soria reacts well to snuff out the attack.
86' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
85' Jose Bordalas Jimenez prepares a substitution. Kiko Femenia is replaced by Javier Munoz (Getafe).
82' Izeta (Ath Bilbao) takes the free kick but it's straight at the goalkeeper.
76' Substitution. Izeta (Ath Bilbao) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Oihan Sancet walks off.
75' 0 - 1 Goal! Borja Mayoral (Getafe) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 0:1.
74' A pass from Mario Martin (Getafe) is intercepted by Unai Simon and the move breaks down.
71' Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
70' Ath Bilbao hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
68' Substitution. Coba da Costa did his best and is replaced by Mario Martin (Getafe).
67' Isidro Diaz interrupts the game. One of the players from Ath Bilbao won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
65' Aymeric Laporte (Ath Bilbao) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
63' Adrian Liso (Getafe) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Unai Simon intercepts the ball.
62' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Luis Milla (Getafe), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
62' Luis Milla (Getafe) works the corner short.
61' Kiko Femenia (Getafe) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Getafe force a corner. They send men into the box.
61' The linesman signals a throw-in for Getafe.
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alex Berenguer departs the field of play to be replaced by Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao).
59' Ernesto Valverde decides to make a substitution. Gorka Guruzeta will be replaced by Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao).
59' Substitution. Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) on for Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta.
57' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
56' The game is interrupted. Adrian Liso (Getafe) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
55' A pass by Luis Milla (Getafe) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is out of play. Ath Bilbao will take a throw-in.

53' Ath Bilbao slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
49' Unai Simon (Ath Bilbao) attempts to send a defence-splitting pass in order to find free space for his teammate.
47' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
46' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Ath Bilbao.
46' Ath Bilbao are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Isidro Diaz has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
43' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
41' Luis Milla (Getafe) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
39' The game is interrupted now, Aymeric Laporte (Ath Bilbao) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
38' Unai Simon displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Adrian Liso (Getafe) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
36' The ball has crossed the sideline. Getafe are taking a throw-in.
32' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao).
31' Ernesto Valverde is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) suffers an injury and Jesus Areso comes on.
30' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
29' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Getafe, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
25' Neat passing move from Getafe in order to create new attacking opportunities.
22' Djene (Getafe) sends an accurate short pass. Diego Rico controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
18' The ball is cleared after Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
15' Adrian Liso (Getafe) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
14' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Getafe.
13' The ball possession at the moment is 57:43.
11' Kiko Femenia (Getafe) sends a long ball in, but Unai Simon comfortably gathers the ball.
10' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Isidro Diaz blows for a foul. Getafe have a free kick.
8' The Getafe players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
4' The Getafe players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
2' Getafe have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Getafe will take the kick-off.
Isidro Diaz is the one to supervise the game today.
